default.translation: A mother tongue is the road home.

ink-and-paper.original: 读书破万卷，下笔如有神。
ink-and-paper.translation: After reading ten thousand books, the brush moves as if alive.

jade-artisan.original: 玉不琢，不成器；人不学，不知道。
jade-artisan.translation: Uncut jade never becomes a vessel; an unlearned mind never finds the way.

long-road.translation: A journey of a thousand li begins beneath your feet.

tea-ceremony.translation: Among any three people, one is my teacher.

bonsai-pruning.original: 教也者，长善而救其失者也。
bonsai-pruning.translation: To teach is to nurture what is good and mend what is lacking.

go-board.translation: Without small steps, there is no thousand-li road.

thread-bound-book.original: 温故而知新，可以为师矣。
thread-bound-book.translation: Revising the old to understand the new — that is how one becomes a teacher.

first-brushstroke.translation: To learn in childhood is like the light of sunrise.
first-brushstroke.source: Yan Zhitui, Family Instructions of the Yan Clan

notFound.title: This page isn't here
notFound.description: The address doesn't exist, has been moved, or never existed.
notFound.reassurance: Don't worry — follow the light back.
